3:9 date-literals The VBE writes #2020-01-15# as #1/15/2020#. [*]
4:9 date-literals The VBE writes #15/1/2020# as #1/15/2020#. [*]
5:9 date-literals The VBE writes #January 15, 2020# as #1/15/2020#. [*]

7:9 date-literals The VBE writes #10:30 PM# as #10:30:00 PM#. [*]
8:9 date-literals The VBE writes #1/1/2000 00:00:00# as #1/1/2000#. [*]
